item.title: linuxPackages.nvidiaPackages.legacy_535: 535.261.03 -> 535.274.02
item.description:
https://nvidia.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/5703/~/security-bulletin%3A-nvidia-gpu-display-drivers---october-2025

Addresses CVE-2025-23280, CVE-2025-23282, CVE-2025-23300, CVE-2025-23330, CVE-2025-23332, CVE-2025-23345

A few notes:

  • I'm unable to test this legacy update on my local system (cc @doronbehar)
  • 535 drivers will reach EOL on June 1, 2026. Technically, this is within the support window of NixOS 25.11, but just barely. We can still make the call of removing it now, before branch off, as it's not supported throughout the whole 25.11 lifecycle, or mark it as potentially vulnerable on June 1, 2026 for NixOS 25.11 while removing it from unstable before 26.05 branch-off.
  • There also is an according update 535.261.03 for the dc_535 drivers that I was unable to build locally, and are thus not included in this PR. cc @edwtjo who originally added these drivers to nixpkgs

Two outstanding CVEs are present in binutils 2.44:

  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-5244
  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-5245

Those links include direct references to the corrective commits, which is what these diffs are derived from.

Although 2.45 includes the fixes, as noted in #431912, the odd-numbered releases exclude gold, which would introduce a lot of breakage, and this should go in sooner than we could get a large breaking change in esp. before 25.11. As discussed in #staging on Matrix; we should deprecate gold eventually but that's out of scope in the immediate-term so that we can just patch these CVEs.

I built this myself to confirm it's buildable but obviously something like binutils lives deep down in the dependency tree so it's branched off staging and will likely cause large rebuilds.
